The possible effect of our action herein on the environment has been fully considered in our environmental impact statement set forth in Appendix C. We have concluded on the basis of this study that zone expansion will not harm the environment. The specialized carriers have raised no matters which would cause us to alter our conclusion.
We recognize that different rates are often charged for the transportation of regulated and unregulated traffic. We do not agree with the unsupported assertion of the household goods carriers, that the increase in the amount of unregula:ed traffic which will result from zone expansion will lead to such rate discrimination in the household goods area as to warrant exclusion of this traffic from the regulations. The issue of consumer protection, particularly in the transportation of household goods, is a primary concern of this Commission. In this regard, we note that no representations on behalf of concerned consumers were filed herein. The impact of the regulations on consumers has been considered, however, and nothing in the record indicates that the interests of consumers would be adversely affected by the new regula-Shippers of other than household goods recognize many advantages to the action being taken herein and household goods shippers are entitled to those same benefits.
